description: Proceed with the Lower Malwathu Oya Multi-purpose Development Project
decision_details_title: Press briefing of Cabinet Decision taken on 2025-12-15 (Subject to Confirmation at the next Meeting)
decision_details_body: - The Lower Malwathu Oya Multipurpose Development Project was initiated in 2016 with the objectives of overcoming water scarcity, which has a major impact on rural development and agricultural production in the Lower Malwathu Oya Valley, creating a new development area in the Thanthirimale area, increasing the intensity of cultivation in 30,690 acres of paddy lands, generating hydropower, and providing drinking water under the Yodha Wewa and Akithamuruppu Wewa in the Mannar District. Approval of the Cabinet has been granted at the meeting held on 20190719 for the total cost estimate of the said project, which is Rs.22,900 million. Although the construction work of the project was initiated by the Department of Irrigation, it was temporarily suspended in 2022 due to the then Covid-19 pandemic and the economic crisis, has now been resumed as per the decision of the Committee of Re-strategizing and Acceleration of Mega Development Projects (RAMP). Based on the recommendation of the Technical Evaluation Committee, the current total cost estimate of the relevant project has been calculated at Rs.47.18 billion. Accordingly, the proposal made by the Minister of Agriculture, Livestock, Land and Irrigation to amend the revised cost estimate of the Lower Malwathu Oya Multipurpose Development Project to Rs.47.18 billion, implement the project under local funds and extend the project period up to 31 December 2030, was approved by the Cabinet.
